description: Deterministic two-stage LP formulation snapshot (Financial Planning Management V4). The optimizer code lives in app/services/budget_service.py; this config pins the solver and the constraint/monitoring contract.

bounds.MINIMUM: l_i = floor, U_i = max(floor, min(ceiling, target))
bounds.FLEXIBLE: l_i = floor, U_i = max(floor, min(ceiling, target))

stages.name: essential_coverage
constraints: x_i >= l_i + r * w_i * (U_i - l_i) for each Essential with U_i > l_i
stages.output: stage-1 x_i becomes the floor for each Essential

surplus: available_funds - sum(x) is returned as unallocated_surplus
